candidate: Two observed samples each side confirm local level stability; replace only a >kappa*sigma isolated fine residual by two-sided level, protect command changes +/-1finebin. Then unchanged native CPOP. Not a new CPOP solver or certified anomaly label.

simulation.sparse: Exactly2 fine bins within task, independent sign*Uniform(.4,.9)kW
simulation.no_upsampling: Generate independent1s ODE and meter10s means directly; never split prior minute measurements.
simulation.reference: Known simulated baseline. No reference predictor used. Truth and contamination labels evaluator-only.

selection: Validation minimum all-kind all-condition mean of cumulative/longest absolute errors; ties choose larger kappa. No real-data or test tuning.

real_auxiliary.selection: Reuse all fixed144 existing events. No error-driven selection or unseen-real claim.
real_auxiliary.truth: No latent truth. Only same-method Gaussian-to-spike feature perturbation stability.
real_auxiliary.features: Observed command-progress target>=.9, task0..15s, dwell.1s; all methods same100ms inputs.

baselines: Original native CPOP1.0.10 beta2log(n), same sigma and full fine grid; unchanged author LABS M5R2 sSIC fixed commit. Both receive same fine observations and commands remain available to all; using them is part of candidate feature block.
scope: First feature block only. No uncertainty intervals counted as benefit. No reports/second block/default replacement.

reuse.scipy: Reviewed scipy GitHub median_filter BSD implementation; do not blindly median smooth or install. Independently implement narrow evidence rule instead.
